messages:
maria (partnerships): Heads-up — vendor sent a partial manifest for the marketplace reserved batch, looks like 40% of the rack nodes are delayed in transit. Impacting Q3 Dedicated onboarding commitments. https://vendor.example.com/shipments/ABC123

jake (logistics): Ugh that sucks. Do we have a detailed manifest or PO mapping? If we can identify which reservations map to the delayed units we can reroute customers to spare-pool or swap partners.

sunil (supply-chain): I pulled the latest feed from the vendor portal earlier. They flagged a customs hold at FRA for one container (ETA pushed). Vendor claims ETA +10 days.

maria (partnerships): Copy. Posting the affected reservation IDs below so eng/sales can triage. Can someone confirm which of these are marketplace commits vs direct enterprise resvs? I want to avoid breaking SLA customers. 

maria (partnerships): ```
RESV-7401
RESV-7402
RESV-7600
RESV-7611
RESV-7622
```

vendor-api-bot: Automated update: shipment ABC123 status changed to "customs_hold" by carrier at 2025-11-03T09:12Z. Estimated release time: unknown. Tracking: https://vendor.example.com/track/ABC123

olivia (sales): RESV-7401 and RESV-7402 are PLG marketplace commitments (low-touch). RESV-7611 is an Enterprise Dedicated contract (SLA). We need a contingency for 7611 first.

sunil (supply-chain): Agreed. Proposed operational mitigation: request vendor to split the manifest and surface any ready-to-ship racks immediately, then apply for temporary pull-forward from our spare-pool for SLA resv 7611. I can open the spare-pool allocation if legal signs off on temporary swap.

alex (legal): Quick Q: do our Dedicated contracts allow temporary substitution with equivalent hardware from a different vendor/lot? I need to check warranty/acceptance clauses. If it's identical specs and we document the substitution, usually ok but will confirm.

jake (logistics): If legal ok, we can do an inter-partner swap. I also recommend we throttle marketplace-only allocations for the next 72h to preserve capacity for SLA customers. Can ops set a temporary routing policy?

maria (partnerships): Ops will need explicit list of reservation IDs to pin. Also want a short customer-facing note ready in case Enterprise sees failover. @olivia can you draft a 1-paragraph holding message? Keep it calm, no technical detail.

olivia (sales): Draft: "We're proactively reallocating capacity to ensure your Dedicated capacity is maintained. You may see a brief change in hardware serials; performance and SLAs remain intact. We'll follow up with exact timing." Thoughts? :thumbsup:

maria (partnerships): Good. Add: "expected timeline: 48-72 hours for confirmation" and include a contact line. I'll own the outbound.

sunil (supply-chain): Action items I have: 1) open spare-pool allocation 2) request vendor to split manifest 3) update marketplace routing to preserve SLA resvs. I'll post updates here.

jake (logistics): Also pinging vendor ops contact directly now: @vendor-ops. If they can release any ready racks we can expedite.

vendor-api-bot: Note: vendor response received for ABC123: "Partial release approved, 3 racks cleared for export — shipment ID ABC123-A." ETA to port: 36 hours.

maria (partnerships): Excellent. Which resvs do the 3 racks correspond to?

sunil (supply-chain): Looks like ABC123-A can cover RESV-7611 and RESV-7622 fully, and partial for RESV-7600. That frees up us to reassign one SLA-critical resv.

alex (legal): Confirmed: substitution is permitted under section 4.2 if equivalent hardware is provided and customer informed within 5 business days. We're good to proceed; keep a paper trail.

maria (partnerships): Ok proceeding with swap plan. Olivia, send the holding message to the enterprise point and mention we may swap serial numbers but not SLAs. Jake, please update routing policy to hold marketplace allocations for affected IDs. Sunil, push spare-pool allocation and post the exact new SKU mapping here. I'll loop in CS.

olivia (sales): Message sent to customer rep. They replied: "Appreciate the heads-up. Please confirm once capacity is live."

jake (logistics): Routing policy updated: marketplace allocations throttled for RESV-7401/7402/7600 until 1738255800. (temporary flag).

sunil (supply-chain): Spare-pool allocation created: SPARE-2025-11-03 -> assigned to RESV-7611. New SKU mapping: GPU-RACK-v3a -> covers SLA.

maria (partnerships): Great. Closing loop: we'll reconvene if vendor pushes new delays. For audit, I'll export this thread and attach to the resv ticket. Thanks team. :raised_hands:

vendor-api-bot: Shipment ABC123-A updated: delivered-to-port ETA 36h, customs_expedite requested.

maria (partnerships): Marking thread resolved for now — follow-ups will be in the resv tickets.
